durability: Report missing historical publication/commit timestamps explicitly; never infer commit from receive or file mtime
outcomes: No trade fills, returns of a strategy, markouts or PnL computed; M1 boolean is reconstructed only to verify derivation
rules: Protocol v2 thresholds unchanged; no daily quota/cooldown; technical prefix is not a new future validation sample
boundary_note: Additional prior raw receipts initialize the first warm-up grid point within its already fixed 120-second freshness rule. Evaluation start, cutoff, protocol, model and thresholds unchanged; no economic outcomes used. Earlier extraction preserved separately.
